tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and the app frame.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, form fields, dialogs and table bodies. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent, ok-fg, warn-fg, bad-fg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, sidebar, inactive segments and disabled fields. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and sections. Carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, switches and checkboxes. At least 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and numbers on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, hints, captions, labels of unsuitable offers. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active navigation, links and the focus ring. As text on surface and surface-raised, as fill with on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active navigation item background and the assumption marker. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ok-fg
tokens.usage: Text and symbol of the green traffic light ("Reserve reicht"). On ok-bg and surface-raised. Always shown with the symbol ✓.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the green traffic light badge and heatmap cell.

tokens.name: warn-fg
tokens.usage: Text and symbol of the yellow traffic light ("knapp") and of warnings. On warn-bg and surface-raised. Always shown with the symbol ▲.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the yellow traffic light badge and heatmap cell.

tokens.name: bad-fg
tokens.usage: Text and symbol of the red traffic light ("reicht nicht") and of errors. On bad-bg and surface-raised. Always shown with the symbol ✕.

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the red traffic light badge, error notice and heatmap cell.

tokens.name: chart-acquisition
tokens.usage: Chart segment: purchase (value loss) or lease. At least 3:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: chart-electricity
tokens.usage: Chart segment: home electricity. At least 3:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: chart-petrol
tokens.usage: Chart segment: petrol. At least 3:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: chart-maintenance
tokens.usage: Chart segment: maintenance and tyres. At least 3:1 on surface-raised.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Area and section titles, page title on mobile.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles and form group titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text and field values. 16px keeps iOS from zooming into fields.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart axes and the line with scenario, price case, period and calculation time. Never below 12px.

styles.name: number-lg
styles.usage: Total cost in tiles. Set with tabular figures.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Values in tables and heatmap cells. Set with tabular figures.

styles.name: formula
styles.usage: Formula references and intermediate values in the Rechenweg.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact groups, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between label and field, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, page gutter on mobile, gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every control on the phone: buttons, fields, switches, navigation items.

tokens.name: control-height-desktop
tokens.usage: Height of fields and buttons from 900px width, where a pointer is used.

tokens.name: nav-bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom navigation bar on the phone.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the sidebar from 900px width.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, heatmap cells, chart segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, buttons, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch track and knob, pill badges.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on surface. Borders carry the structure, the shadow only lifts a dialog.
